"""Author-only AST/byte checks and immutable capsule; no project import/run."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import zlib

BASE = Path('/workspace/scratch/dda74a4fae35')
KIT = BASE / 'v119-inspect-policy-execution-r1'
R1 = BASE / 'v119-inspect-policy-owner-r1'
R20 = BASE / 'v120-union-r20/source'


def wire(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True) + '\n').encode()


def pin(raw):
    return {'bytes': len(raw), 'mode': '100644', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()}


def write(path, raw):
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)


def tree(files):
    root = {}
    for path, row in files.items():
        parts = path.split('/'); current = root
        for part in parts[:-1]: current = current.setdefault(part, {})
        assert parts[-1] not in current
        current[parts[-1]] = row
    def digest(value):
        rows = []
        for name, row in value.items():
            if 'git_blob' in row:
                rows.append((name.encode(), row['mode'].encode(), bytes.fromhex(row['git_blob'])))
            else:
                rows.append(((name+'/').encode(), b'40000', digest(row)))
        raw = b''.join(mode + b' ' + name.rstrip(b'/') + b'\0' + sha for name, mode, sha in sorted(rows))
        return hashlib.sha1(b'tree ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).digest()
    return digest(root).hex()


def main():
    publication = KIT / 'publication'; publication.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    static = {'schema':'hepta.hia.inspect-execution-authoring-static.v1',
              'status':'STATIC_AUTHORING_CHECKS_ONLY', 'checks':[],
              'project_imports':0, 'generation':0, 'product_tests':0,
              'native_compilation':0, 'native_execution':0, 'vm_execution':0,
              'full_base_copy':False, 'qualification_inherited':False}
    capsule = json.loads((KIT/'inputs/R1-SOURCE-TRANSPORT.json').read_bytes())
    decoded = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(capsule['data'], validate=True))
    assert pin(decoded) == capsule['payload']
    overlay = json.loads(decoded)
    assert overlay['schema'] == 'hepta.hia.inspect-policy-authoring-source.v1'
    base = json.loads((KIT/'inputs/R20-SOURCE-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes())
    assert len(base) == 3177 and tree(base) == 'f137ac1733a4f6d1e434ef10531952a139c4015a'
    prepared = dict(base)
    for name,row in overlay['files'].items():
        raw = row['text'].encode()
        assert pin(raw) == {key:row['after'][key] for key in ('bytes','mode','sha256','git_blob')}
        assert (R1/'source'/name).read_bytes() == raw
        if row['before'] is None:
            assert name not in base and not (R20/name).exists()
        else:
            old = row['before']['text'].encode()
            assert old == (R20/name).read_bytes() and pin(old) == base[name]
        prepared[name] = pin(raw)
    assert len(overlay['files']) == 8 and len(prepared) == 3184
    existing = overlay['files']['hepta/hia_program_tools.py']
    assert existing['text'].encode().startswith(existing['before']['text'].encode())
    assert len(existing['text'].encode()) - len(existing['before']['text'].encode()) == 744
    static['checks'].append({'name':'complete R20 map and all eight frozen overlay preimages/after bytes',
                             'base_files':len(base),'base_tree':tree(base),
                             'prepared_files':len(prepared),'prepared_tree':tree(prepared)})
    fixture = json.loads(overlay['files']['tests/fixtures/hia_inspect_program_originals.json']['text'])
    old_ids=[]
    for name,row in fixture['test_sources'].items():
        raw=(R20/name).read_bytes()
        assert len(raw)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
        assert pin(raw)['git_blob']==row['git_blob']
        old_ids.extend(x['id'] for x in row['selected_methods'])
    assert len(old_ids)==3 and len(fixture['original_cli_ids'])==43
    static['checks'].append({'name':'all four original test files complete bytes; original3 and CLI43 IDs',
                             'test_files':{name:{key:row[key] for key in ('bytes','sha256','git_blob')} for name,row in fixture['test_sources'].items()}})
    spec=json.loads((KIT/'EXECUTION-SPEC.json').read_bytes())
    assert spec['groups']['original3']==old_ids and spec['groups']['original-cli43']==fixture['original_cli_ids']
    syntax={}
    for path in sorted(KIT.glob('*.py')):
        raw=path.read_bytes(); parsed=ast.parse(raw, filename=str(path)); syntax[path.name]=pin(raw)
        for node in parsed.body:
            if isinstance(node, (ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom)):
                names = [alias.name for alias in node.names] if isinstance(node,ast.Import) else [node.module or '']
                assert not any(name=='hepta' or name.startswith('hepta.') or name=='tools' or name.startswith('tools.') for name in names)
    assert len(syntax)==4
    static['checks'].append({'name':'four complete Python files parse; no top-level product import', 'files':syntax})
    declared={}
    for filename,module in (('inspect_exec_cases.py','inspect_exec_cases'),('inspect_exec_vm.py','inspect_exec_vm')):
        for cls in ast.parse((KIT/filename).read_bytes()).body:
            if isinstance(cls,ast.ClassDef):
                for fn in cls.body:
                    if isinstance(fn,ast.FunctionDef) and fn.name.startswith('test_'):
                        declared[module+'.'+cls.name+'.'+fn.name] = ast.get_source_segment((KIT/filename).read_text(),fn)
    new_ids=[name for group in spec['native_group_order']+spec['vm_group_order'] for name in spec['groups'][group]]
    assert len(new_ids)==29 and len(set(new_ids))==29 and set(new_ids)==set(declared)
    assert len([x for x in new_ids if '.InspectFrameVMTests.' in x])==12
    for group in spec['native_group_order']:
        if group.startswith('inspect-lost-'): assert len(spec['groups'][group])==1
    source_tree=ast.parse(overlay['files']['tests/test_hia_inspect_program_source.py']['text'])
    cls=next(n for n in source_tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name=='InspectProgramSourceTests')
    actual_source_ids=['tests.test_hia_inspect_program_source.'+cls.name+'.'+f.name for f in cls.body if isinstance(f,ast.FunctionDef) and f.name.startswith('test_')]
    assert actual_source_ids==spec['groups']['source10'] and len(actual_source_ids)==10
    static['checks'].append({'name':'exact declared Source10/new Native17/VM12; four fault groups are individual children',
                             'groups':spec['groups']})
    support=ast.parse((KIT/'inspect_exec_support.py').read_bytes())
    constants={target.id:ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in support.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) for target in n.targets if isinstance(target,ast.Name) and target.id in ('CAPACITY','VM_STEPS','VM_CALL_DEPTH','SECONDS','CLEANUP','COMPILE_SECONDS')}
    assert constants=={'CAPACITY':1048576,'VM_STEPS':10000000,'VM_CALL_DEPTH':128,'SECONDS':180,'CLEANUP':3,'COMPILE_SECONDS':20}
    parent=ast.parse((KIT/'run_inspect_development.py').read_bytes())
    calls=[n for n in ast.walk(parent) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='run_owned']
    assert len(calls)==1
    keywords={x.arg:ast.unparse(x.value) for x in calls[0].keywords}
    assert keywords['qualification_seconds']=='SECONDS' and keywords['cleanup_seconds']=='CLEANUP'
    assert keywords['supervisor_env']==keywords['env']=='env'
    cases=ast.parse((KIT/'inspect_exec_cases.py').read_bytes())
    loss=next(n for n in ast.walk(cases) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='intercepted')
    assert any(isinstance(n,ast.Compare) and ast.unparse(n)=='w is frame.state' for n in ast.walk(loss))
    journal=next(n for n in ast.walk(support) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='invoke')
    assert any(isinstance(n,ast.Try) and n.finalbody and any(isinstance(c,ast.Call) and isinstance(c.func,ast.Attribute) and c.func.attr=='original' for c in ast.walk(n)) for n in ast.walk(journal))
    vm=ast.parse((KIT/'inspect_exec_vm.py').read_bytes())
    replay=next(n for n in ast.walk(vm) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='replay')
    assert any(isinstance(n,ast.Try) and n.finalbody for n in ast.walk(replay))
    static['checks'].append({'name':'original static budgets, same supervisor/child env, actual-root fault targeting, buffer-finally structure', 'constants':constants})
    for name in spec['generated_only']:
        assert not (R1/'source'/name).exists()
    static['checks'].append({'name':'three inspect generated outputs remain absent; authoring did not execute generation'})
    static['limitations']=['AST and byte checks are not product execution.',
                          'Actual inflight-reentry boundary may fail and has not been fixed or qualified.',
                          'R20 prepared tree is pinned; no formal-final-tree metadata equivalence is inferred.',
                          'No current-cold/installed-inspect/CLI-op10/whole qualification.']
    write(KIT/'STATIC-REPORT.json',wire(static))
    files={}
    for path in sorted(KIT.rglob('*')):
        if path.is_file() and 'publication' not in path.relative_to(KIT).parts:
            files[path.relative_to(KIT).as_posix()]=pin(path.read_bytes())
    index={'schema':'hepta.hia.inspect-execution-kit-pins.v1','files':files,
           'self_excluded_from_files':True,'external_authority':'reviewed exact --kit-index-sha256 argument',
           'product_execution':0}
    write(KIT/'KIT-PINS.json',wire(index))
    payload={'schema':'hepta.hia.inspect-execution-kit-source.v1','base':'FIRST_AUTHORING_ALL_PATHS_NEW',
             'files':{name:{'before':None,'after':{**row,'text':(KIT/name).read_text()},'text':(KIT/name).read_text()} for name,row in {**files,'KIT-PINS.json':pin((KIT/'KIT-PINS.json').read_bytes())}.items()},
             'product_overlay_unchanged':'8e91c8be30734df36217b5d37f7f226b5abbb154'}
    payload_raw=wire(payload)
    transport={'schema':'hia.zlib-base64-capsule.v1','encoding':'zlib+base64','payload':pin(payload_raw),
               'data':base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(payload_raw,9)).decode()}
    transported=wire(transport)
    assert zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(transport['data']))==payload_raw
    write(publication/'SOURCE-TRANSPORT.json',transported)
    write(publication/'STATIC-REPORT.json',(KIT/'STATIC-REPORT.json').read_bytes())
    write(publication/'EXECUTION-SPEC.json',(KIT/'EXECUTION-SPEC.json').read_bytes())
    write(publication/'EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md',(KIT/'EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md').read_bytes())
    evidence={'schema':'hepta.hia.inspect-executor-authoring-evidence.v1',
              'author_script':{'path':str(Path(__file__)),'text':Path(__file__).read_text(),**pin(Path(__file__).read_bytes())},
              'initial_input_readback':json.loads((KIT/'INPUT-READBACK.json').read_bytes()),
              'static_report':static,'product_execution':0}
    write(publication/'AUTHORING-EVIDENCE.json',wire(evidence))
    summary={'schema':'hepta.hia.inspect-execution-kit-summary.v1','status':'AUTHORED_NOT_EXECUTED',
             'kit':str(KIT),'source_transport':pin(transported),'decoded_source':pin(payload_raw),
             'kit_index':pin((KIT/'KIT-PINS.json').read_bytes()),'files':len(payload['files']),
             'base_tree':tree(base),'prepared_tree':tree(prepared),'prepared_files':len(prepared),
             'declared_counts':spec['declared_counts'],'full_base_copy':False,'source_product_edits':0,
             'generation':0,'product_tests':0,'native_compile':0,'native_execution':0,'vm_execution':0,
             'matching_current_cold':False,'whole_cli_native':False,
             'next':'Root review before any execution; minimum free 1GiB and exact pinned runtime required.',
             'future_argv':[json.loads((KIT/'inputs/B3-REUSE-SIZE-PLAN.json').read_bytes())['interpreter']['argv0'],
                            '-I','-B',str(KIT/'run_inspect_development.py'),'--execute-development',
                            '--base-source',str(R20),'--attempt',str(BASE/'v119-inspect-policy-attempt-r1'),
                            '--kit-index-sha256',hashlib.sha256((KIT/'KIT-PINS.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()]}
    write(publication/'SUMMARY.json',wire(summary))
    plan={'schema':'hepta.hia.inspect-execution-publication-plan.v1','items':[{'name':p.name,'path':str(p),**pin(p.read_bytes())} for p in sorted(publication.iterdir()) if p.is_file()]}
    write(publication/'UPLOAD-PLAN.json',wire(plan))
    print(json.dumps({'status':'AUTHORING_STATIC_COMPLETE_ZERO_PRODUCT','files':len(payload['files']),
                      'payload_bytes':len(payload_raw),'transport_bytes':len(transported),
                      'prepared_tree':tree(prepared),'declared_counts':spec['declared_counts'],
                      'kit_index_sha256':summary['kit_index']['sha256']}))


if __name__=='__main__':main()
